name: Pinazepam
summary: Benzodiazepine that is solely an anxiolytic drug that lacks the hypnotic and significant motor impairment that typical benzodiazepines do. The main metabolite of this drug is nordazepam and to a lesser effect oxazepam, which is where it is suggested to get most of its effects

helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: In humans pinazepam acts as a pure anxiolytic agent in that it does not possess to any significant degree the other pharmacological characteristics of benzodiazepines.

uses.text: Pinazepam (marketed under the brand name Domar and Duna) is a benzodiazepine drug.

summaryZh: 匹那西泮（英語：Pinazepam），商品名為Domar和Duna，是一種苯二氮䓬類藥物。它具有抗焦慮、抗驚厥、鎮靜和骨骼肌鬆弛作用。
summaryZhHans: 匹那西泮（英语：Pinazepam），商品名为Domar和Duna，是一种苯二氮䓬类药物。它具有抗焦虑、抗惊厥、镇静和骨骼肌松弛作用。

sideEffects.en: Benzodiazepines cause drowsiness, poor coordination, slurred speech and memory gaps. Regular use leads to tolerance and dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause seizures, which can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 苯二氮平類會造成嗜睡、協調變差、口齒不清與記憶斷片。規律使用會產生耐受性與依賴，大量使用後突然停藥可能引發癲癇發作，甚至有生命危險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 苯二氮平类会造成嗜睡、协调制差、口齿不清与记忆断片。规律使用会产生耐受性与依赖，大量使用后突然停药可能引发癫痫发作，甚至有生命危险。

fact.en: It carries a propargyl group, a carbon chain with a triple bond, on its nitrogen, which is unusual for a benzodiazepine. The body turns it into nordazepam.
fact.zh: 它的氮原子上帶有炔丙基，也就是含三鍵的碳鏈，這在苯二氮平中相當少見。人體會把它轉變成去甲西泮。
fact.zhHans: 它的氮原子上带有炔丙基，也就是含三键的碳链，这在苯二氮平中相当少见。人体会把它转变成去甲西泮。
